## Tracer interface

Where a run reports what it does, as spans: the run (`hopgraph.run`<!-- -->); each job, the reads of one loader in one wave (`hopgraph.batch`<!-- -->); and under a job its cache read (`hopgraph.cache.read`<!-- -->), its dry runs (`hopgraph.price`<!-- -->), its calls (`hopgraph.load`<!-- -->) and its cache writes (`hopgraph.cache.write`<!-- -->). A span is a child of the one given as `parent`<!-- -->. Shaped so that an OpenTelemetry tracer adapts in a few lines (examples/otel.ts). An error one of its methods throws never reaches the run: the run goes on, and that span may lack what the call was to give it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Tracer 
```
